Check: Default zone policy set to No Access
CLI Command: defzone --show → must return 'No Access'
GUI: Web Tools / SANnav: Zoning > Default Zone

Check: No multi-initiator zones (exactly 1 initiator WWN per zone)
CLI Command: zoneshow → count members per zone; initiator WWNs are host HBAs
GUI: Web Tools: Zoning > Zone Admin — review member counts

Check: No zones with wildcard or all membership
CLI Command: zoneshow → grep for any zone with * or unexpectedly large member counts

Check: No stale zones (WWNs not present in fabric)
CLI Command: nsshow (fabric nameserver) vs zoneshow — cross-reference WWNs

Check: Zone aliases used for all WWNs
CLI Command: alishow — every WWN in active zones should appear in an alias
GUI: Web Tools: Zoning > Zone Admin > Aliases

Check: DH-CHAP enabled on all ISLs / E-ports
CLI Command: authutil --show → policy must be 'on' (enforced) or 'passive'
CIS Controls v8: CIS 4.2 (Secure Config - Network); CIS 6.3 (Access Control - MFA)

Check: SCC policy active (only known switches can join fabric)
CLI Command: sccpolicyshow → should list permitted switch WWNs
CIS Controls v8: CIS 4.2 (Secure Config - Network); CIS 12.2 (Network Infrastructure Mgmt)

Check: DCC policy active (only known devices on specific ports)
CLI Command: dccpolicyshow

Check: No unauthorized switches in fabric
CLI Command: fabricshow → verify every switch is expected
CIS Controls v8: CIS 1.1 (Asset Inventory - Establish and maintain); CIS 12.2

Check: Telnet disabled
CLI Command: ipfilter --show → verify no rule permits port 23
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 2.2.5 (Disable unnecessary services/ports); Req 4.2.1 (No cleartext transmission)

Check: HTTP disabled (HTTPS only)
CLI Command: httpscertshow → confirm HTTPS cert present; attempt http://switch-ip — should fail
GUI: Web Tools: Switch Admin > Security > Protocols

Check: Default admin password changed
CLI Command: Cannot verify via CLI — confirm with team / check last password change date

Check: No shared or generic accounts
CLI Command: userconfig --show -a → flag any named admin / user / readonly not tied to a person
CIS Controls v8: CIS 5.1 (Account Management - Establish and maintain inventory)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 8.2.1 (All user IDs are unique); Req 8.2.2 (No group/shared credentials)

Check: RBAC roles correctly assigned (least-privilege)
CLI Command: userconfig --show -a → verify roles: admin / operator / securityadmin

Check: SSH-only remote access (Telnet blocked)
CLI Command: sshutil --show → SSH enabled; ipfilter --show → port 22 open / port 23 closed
CIS Controls v8: CIS 4.8; CIS 12.6 (Network Infrastructure Mgmt - Use secure protocols)

Check: Management IP access restricted by ACL to management subnet
CLI Command: ipfilter --show → allow rules scoped to management subnet only
GUI: Web Tools: Switch Admin > IP Filter
CIS Controls v8: CIS 12.2 (Network Infrastructure Mgmt - Maintain secure network arch)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 1.3.2 (Restrict inbound traffic); Req 1.4.1 (NSCs between trusted and untrusted networks)

Check: Audit logging enabled
CLI Command: auditcfg --show → must show filter entries for security events
CIS Controls v8: CIS 8.2 (Audit Log Management - Collect audit logs)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 10.2.1 (Audit log events); Req 10.3.2 (Protect audit logs from destruction)

Check: Syslog configured to remote SIEM
CLI Command: syslogdipadd list → should show SIEM IP
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 10.5.1 (Retain audit logs); Req 10.6.1 (Transmit logs to centralized server)

Check: Firmware at current supported level (check Broadcom CVEs)
CLI Command: version → compare against Broadcom FOS release notes
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 6.3.3 (All software protected from known vulnerabilities); Req 11.3.1

Check: No volumes presented to wildcard / all-hosts
CLI Command: showvlun -t → flag any entry with host * or no host restriction
GUI: SSMC: Block Persona > Virtual Volumes > Exports — filter by host
CIS Controls v8: CIS 6.1 (Access Control - Establish); CIS 3.3 (Data Protection - Configure data access)

Check: Each ESX host or cluster in its own host set
CLI Command: showhostset → verify host sets map 1:1 to clusters; no mixing of unrelated hosts
GUI: SSMC: Block Persona > Hosts > Host Sets

Check: LUN 0 not presented to ESX hosts
CLI Command: showvlun -t → check for lun=0 exports to VMware hosts
GUI: SSMC: Virtual Volumes > Exports — sort by LUN ID

Check: iSCSI ports use mutual CHAP (if iSCSI in use)
CLI Command: showport -iscsi then showiscsisession → verify CHAP negotiated
CIS Controls v8: CIS 4.2; CIS 6.3 (Access Control - Require MFA for remote access)

Check: Default Administrator account disabled or renamed
CLI Command: showuser -d Administrator → check if active
CIS Controls v8: CIS 5.2 (Account Management - Use unique passwords / disable defaults)

Check: Named accounts only (no shared credentials)
CLI Command: showuser → flag any non-personal account names
CIS Controls v8: CIS 5.1 (Account Management - Establish and maintain inventory)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 8.2.1 (Unique user ID); Req 8.2.2 (No shared credentials)

Check: Least-privilege roles assigned (no unnecessary super role)
CLI Command: showuser -d <username> → verify roles; backup operators must not have super

Check: MFA enabled (if SSMC version supports it)
CLI Command: showsys → check SSMC version; then review auth policy
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 8.4.2 (MFA for all access into CDE); Req 8.5.1

Check: API client credentials rotated and inventoried
CLI Command: No direct CLI — review REST API client registrations
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 8.3.7 (Passwords/passphrases not the same as last 4); Req 8.6.2

Check: Audit logging enabled and shipped to SIEM
CLI Command: showsys -detail → check log config; verify remote syslog target
CIS Controls v8: CIS 8.2 (Audit Log Management - Collect audit logs)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 10.2.1; Req 10.6.1 (Forward logs to centralized server)

Check: Management interface on OOB / management VLAN only
CLI Command: shownet → verify management IP is not on a data VLAN
CIS Controls v8: CIS 12.2 (Network Infrastructure Mgmt - Maintain secure network arch)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 1.3.2; Req 1.4.1 (NSCs between trusted and untrusted networks)

Check: HTTPS only for SSMC / REST API (TLS 1.2+)
CLI Command: showcert → verify cert valid and not expired; openssl s_client -connect <ssmc-ip>:443
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 4.2.1 (Strong cryptography for data in transit); Req 2.2.5

Check: Firmware at current HPE supported level
CLI Command: showsys → compare against HPE Support Center advisories

Check: Snapshot schedules have retention limits set
CLI Command: showsched → verify each schedule has expiry / retention; unlimited retention fills pool
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 12.3.4 (Review hardware/software for adequacy); Req 3.2.1 (Data retention policy)

Check: Replication traffic encrypted (if remote copy in use)
CLI Command: showrcopy → verify link encryption; showport -rcip for IP-based replication
CIS Controls v8: CIS 3.10 (Data Protection - Encrypt sensitive data in transit)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 4.2.1 (Strong cryptography for data in transit)

Check: Replication peer authentication configured (not none)
CLI Command: showrcopy targets → verify target auth not set to none
GUI: SSMC: Data Protection > Remote Copy > Targets

Check: ESX hosts only enumerate their assigned LUNs (no cross-visibility)
CLI Command: esxcli storage san fc list; esxcli storage core path list → verify no unexpected storage paths
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Storage Adapters > Targets

Check: NPIV disabled if not actively used
CLI Command: esxcli storage san fc npiv list → should be empty if unused
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Storage Adapters — check for NPIV ports

Check: HPE Alletra VAAI plugin installed from HPE (not third-party substitute)
CLI Command: esxcli software vib list | grep -i hpe → confirm HPE VIB present
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Software > Installed Packages
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 6.3.2 (Maintain inventory of bespoke and custom software)

Check: ESX lockdown mode enabled on all production hosts
CLI Command: vim-cmd vimsvc/auth/lockdown_is_enabled → should return true
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Security Profile > Lockdown Mode

Check: ESX Shell disabled on production hosts
CLI Command: esxcli system settings advanced get -o /UserVars/ESXiShellInteractiveTimeOut
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Security Profile > Services — ESX Shell

Check: SSH disabled on production hosts
CLI Command: esxcli network firewall ruleset list | grep sshServer → should be disabled
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Security Profile > Services — SSH

Check: ESX management on dedicated management VLAN (not shared with storage or VM traffic)
CLI Command: esxcli network ip interface list → management vmk VLAN must differ from storage and VM VLANs
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Networking > VMkernel Adapters
CIS Controls v8: CIS 12.2 (Network Infrastructure Mgmt - Maintain secure network arch)
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 1.3.2; Req 1.4.1 (NSCs between trusted and untrusted networks)

Check: No shared administrator@vsphere.local — named accounts only in vCenter
CLI Command: Cannot verify via CLI — confirm with team
GUI: vCenter: Administration > Access Control > Roles and Users
PCI DSS v4.0: Req 8.2.1 (Unique user ID); Req 8.2.2 (No shared/generic credentials)

Check: HBA firmware at current HPE-certified level (check VMware HCL and HPE SPP)
CLI Command: esxcli storage san fc list → note driver/firmware version; cross-check HPE SPP and VMware HCL
GUI: vCenter: Host > Configure > Storage Adapters — driver / firmware version
